entities.summary: Hoesan Gam clan is one of the Korean clans. Their Bon-gwan is in Changwon, South Gyeongsang Province. According to the research held in 2000, the number of Hoesan Gam clan’s member was in 679 households 2113 members out of 4892 total Gam members. Their founder was Gam Gyu who was a Hanlin Academy in Yuan dynasty. He entered Goryeo in 1349. He was there as a fatherly master when Princess Noguk had a marriage to an ordinary person planned by Gongmin of Goryeo. He made Hoesan, Hoesan Gam clan’s Bon-gwan and founded Hoesan Gam clan because Gam Cheol, 16 th descendant of Gam Gyu, was appointed as Jinzi Guanglu Daifu and became Prince of Hoesan.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: The Hoesan Gam clan's influence on Korean history is significant due to their role in shaping the Goryeo dynasty's succession and politics. The clan's founder, Gam Gyu, played a key part in Princess Noguk's marriage plans, leading to the establishment of the Hoesan Bon-gwan and the founding of the Hoesan Gam clan.
